app.title: GROMACS Insight Platform
app.summary: A person uploads one or more analysis output files from a simulation run, and each is classified by the quantity it holds. They plot the traces, overlay several files on one chart, smooth or rescale them, and for per-residue files rank the most flexible positions. Pressing Analyze gives each trace descriptive statistics, an estimated equilibration point and a heuristic stability score with warnings, and runs a two-sample test on pairs of files of the same type. They leave with a Markdown or PDF report, chart images and the parsed data as CSV.

task.text: Check whether simulation output traces have settled and look stable, compare runs, and produce a report of the checks.

data.text: Text analysis output from molecular dynamics runs: time series of structural, energetic and thermodynamic quantities, plus per-residue fluctuation profiles.
data.item: one output file holding a single quantity over simulation time (or over residue index)

stage.text: checking finished simulation runs for equilibration and stability, before publication-grade analysis

mechanism.text: A sidebar takes the uploads and the chart options that every plot below obeys; a quick-view chart overlays chosen files and a bar chart ranks per-residue values, while an Analyze button opens per-file metric cards, pairwise comparisons and a report built from the same computed numbers. A file picker at the bottom shows any file's parsed table and summary statistics for CSV export.

field.text: trajectory analysis of molecular dynamics simulations in computational chemistry

workflow.name: check whether measured traces have settled, compare runs, and report

steps.here: Upload several .xvg or md.log files; each is parsed and auto-classified (RMSD, RMSF, Rg, SASA, H-bonds, energy, temperature, pressure) and shown as a badge with its row count

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: Pick files and a shared column to overlay on one line, scatter or area chart, with frame downsampling, ps/ns axis, log Y and an optional moving-average overlay; save the chart as PNG, SVG or PDF

steps.step: identify the positions that stand out
steps.here: For per-residue fluctuation files, a slider sets N and the top-N most flexible residues are highlighted in a bar chart and listed in a table

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Analyze gives each trace mean, std, 95% CI, a block-based equilibration estimate and a 0-100 stability score with warnings and recommendations; a text box answers questions using only those computed numbers
When exactly two files share a detected type, a Welch t-test reports mean difference, t and p with an autocorrelation caveat
Download a Markdown or PDF report of overview, stability, statistics, comparisons and flagged issues, and any file's parsed table as CSV

distinctive: The quantity in each file is guessed from its filename, then from its header text, and that guess decides how it is scored and whether it is treated as a time series or a per-residue profile

Stability is scored differently per quantity: coefficient of variation after equilibration for plateauing quantities, variation around the setpoint for temperature, and back-half drift slope for noisy pressure and energy
Equilibration is the first block whose mean falls within tolerance of the final quarter of the run and stays there for every later block
The question box is a rule-based explainer that only quotes numbers already computed, never free-generated text
Statistical outputs carry explicit caveats that consecutive frames are autocorrelated, so CIs and p-values are rough signals
